title: Work Permit Process in UAE: A Step-by-Step Guide
description: Know the work permit process in UAE? This guide simplifies the steps, requirements, and other. Learn everything you need to know!

breadcrumb.name: Work Permit Process in UAE: A Step-by-Step Guide

contentHtml:
Around the world, the UAE is a hub for expats. Its growing economy and numerous opportunities are the main reasons. This continues to attract a diverse workforce. Securing a work permit is an essential step. Foreign nationals need it to live and work in the UAE. While a residence visa is necessary to live in the UAE. At this point, it’s important to understand that a separate work permit is required. This permits to work legally in the country. The process means that employees and employers comply with labor laws. It protects workers and maintains fair business practices.

The guide walks you through the steps involved. Explore:

  • How to obtain a UAE work permit, including
  • Eligibility, required documents, associated costs, and
  • The process of work permits UAE check.

Eligibility Criteria for a UAE Work Permit

The employee and the employer must meet the criteria before applying for a work permit. Established by the UAE authorities. These regulations ensure that workers are hired legally. Assuring that the employment contract aligns with UAE labour laws.

Eligibility Requirements

Requirement Details
Minimum Age Applicants must be 18 years old. There is no upper age limit. However, those over 65 may face higher fees.
Valid Employer License The employer must hold a valid commercial license from the UAE government.
Compliance Record The employer should not have any violations or penalties on record with the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE).
Job Role Compliance The position applying for aligns with the business activities and industry scope.

Who Can Apply for a UAE Work Permit?

The UAE work visa is open to foreign nationals. Those who meet the MoHRE standards. Workers are categorized based on their educational qualifications and skill levels. The permit type they qualify for depends on their category.

Categories of Workers

Category Qualifications
Category 1 Bachelor’s degree or higher
Category 2 Post-secondary diploma
Category 3 High school diploma or equivalent

Applicants must submit their qualifications proofs. The work permit will be issued under the appropriate category based on this.

Documents Required for a UAE Work Permit

Several documents are necessary when applying for a work permit. The applicant and the employer must submit the required paperwork. This validates the application is processed smoothly.

Documents Needed for a Work Permit Application:

The below documents are required to apply for a work permit. The permit is needed before your employment starts. This way, temporary work permit Dubai benefits can’t be ignored, Look out for the documents required to get started:

Document Details
Original Passport Along with a clear photocopy of the passport.
Passport-size Photo Must meet the specifications set by UAE authorities.
Academic Qualifications Copies of educational credentials. These are attested by the UAE embassy and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Medical Certificate A health certificate from a government-approved UAE health center.
Employer Documents Employer’s commercial license and company card copy.

How to Obtain a Work Permit in the UAE

Obtaining a UAE work permit is largely handled by your employer. He/she will apply on your behalf. The MoHRE is responsible for issuing work permits. The process is simple yet easy.

Step-by-Step Work Permit Process in UAE

Step Description
Employer Application Your employer applies for the work permit on your behalf through MoHRE’s online portal, Tas’Heel.
Document Submission The required documents are submitted to MoHRE for review.
Review Process MoHRE reviews the application and may request additional documents or corrections.
Approval Issued Once approved, your employer can download the work permit approval from MoHRE’s system.

UAE Work Permit Fees

Work permit fees vary depending on the worker’s category. Based on the skill level of the job. The employer is responsible for covering the temporary work permit UAE cost. Along with the visa fees. The following is a fee breakdown. It is based on the employee category.

Work Permit Fee Breakdown

Category Fee for Initial Approval Fee for New Electronic Work Permit
Category 1 AED 200 AED 300
Category 2 AED 200 AED 600 (Level A), AED 1,500 (Level B), AED 2,000 (Level C)
Category 3 AED 200 AED 5,000
Workers Over 65 AED 5,000 AED 5,000

MOHRE Work Permit UAE Processing Time

The work permit is processed within 5 working days. It does so once the employer submits all required documents and the application is complete. Delays can occur if additional documentation is needed. Therefore, ensuring all paperwork is in order before submission is essential.

Validity of a Work Permit

A UAE work permit is valid for 30 days. It can be extended for another 30 days. This provides 60 days to stay in the UAE. Your employer ensures that you obtain the following to live and work during this time:

  • Residence Visa: The employer must apply for the visa. Giving you the legal right to stay in the UAE.
  • Labour Card: Required to work in the UAE.
  • Emirates ID: An identity card is issued by the UAE government.

The Residence Visa can be valid for 1 to 3 years. It depends on the job type and the UAE authority’s decision.

Steps to Obtain a UAE Work Visa

Follow additional steps after obtaining a work permit. This way, you can receive your official work visa. It is also known as the Residence Visa. Below is the breakdown:

Step Action
Employer Applies for Visa Your employer applies for your Residence Visa. They apply through the GDRFA.
Visa Approval If approved, the GDRFA affixes your Residence Visa to your passport.
Labour Card and Emirates ID Receive your Labour Card and Emirates ID after your Residence Visa is issued.

The Residence Visa grants you the legal right. You are free to live and work in the UAE.

Work Visa Renewal Process

UAE work visas are valid for 1-3 years, depending on the contract. Renew your work visa before it expires. This way, you can continue working in the UAE. For instance, the renewal process is similar to the application process. It should be done within 30 days. Just before the expiry date.

Step Action
Employer Submits Renewal Your employer applies for a renewal through the GDRFA.
Renewal Confirmation Once approved, your employer receives the renewed work visa.

Getting a Work Permit for Dubai

For a work visa, Dubai follows the same procedure as the other Emirates. However, there are some specifics you should be aware of.

Step Action
Apply for a Job Look for jobs on job portals or while on a tourist visa.
Employer Applies for Work Permit On your behalf, the employer applies for a work permit through the MoHRE.
Entry to Dubai Use the approved work permit to enter Dubai.
Residence Visa Application After entering Dubai, your employer applies for your Residence Visa.
Receive Emirates ID and Labour Card Once the Residence Visa is issued, you’ll receive your Emirates ID and Labour Card.
